title: Symmetry under coordinate permutations
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a set, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f\colon\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The function $f$ is invariant under coordinate permutations if, for every permutation $\sigma$ of the $n$ coordinate positions, evaluating $f$ after reindexing its input by $i\mapsto\sigma(i)$ gives the same function $f$.
